messages:
Casey (PM): Heads-up — noticed confusion in the Prompt Evals regression diff page when using the bulk-select checkbox. Clicking the header checkbox highlights visible rows but the toast says "All 12 results selected" which reads like every result in the run is selected. Can we align copy/behavior? Maria (Design): Yeah that wording is ambiguous. Two quick paths: keep current behavior and change copy to "12 results on this page selected" OR add a banner that lets people "Select all 234 results" (runs can be filtered so count varies). Which feels least surprising? Jordan (Frontend): Implementation note: a true "select all results in run" needs server support to apply actions by query (or supply full id list). Not blocking but requires careful contract — especially with filters/pagination. Ava (A11y): From an accessibility POV we need explicit announcements for each state. If we implement tri-state selection (none/page/all) the change must be announced via aria-live, e.g. "12 results on this page selected" or "All 234 results selected". Keyboard users should get the same feedback. Riley (Eng): Backend plan: expose an endpoint that accepts either an explicit id array for small selections or a "select_all=true + filter" flag which runs a job to operate on the set. Also add an operation id so UI can poll status. Casey (PM): I prefer a low-effort UX-first fix: make the copy explicit for page-selection and expose a small banner CTA "Select all 234 results" that users can click to escalate. That avoids a big infra lift immediately. Maria (Design): OK I'll mock two states in Figma: (A) page-only: header checkbox + toast text "12 results on this page selected" with Undo and (B) page + banner: toast shows "12 selected — Select all 234 results" and a persistent banner appears offering "Select all". Also propose inline text for bulk action buttons: "Approve selected (12)". Jordan (Frontend): Quick prototype sketch for the aria pieces: ```
12 results on this page selected
``` We'll need to update aria-checked when toggling and ensure the banner is focusable via keyboard. Ava (A11y): Important: ensure the toast/banner is reachable by keyboard (tab) and that Esc dismisses it. Provide an accessible Undo button with descriptive label like "Undo selection (12 results)". Also publish the keyboard shortcut in the help docs. Riley (Eng): For the "select all" banner escalation, we'll implement a server-side job and return a job id. Actions on huge sets will be queued to avoid timeouts. Also will set a threshold (e.g., 1k items) to surface a stronger confirmation. Casey (PM): Microcopy suggestion for the toast and banner: - Toast (page): "12 results on this page selected. [Select all 234 results] [Undo]" - Banner after select all: "All 234 results selected. Actions will run in background; view progress in Run Activity. [Undo]" Maria (Design): For confirmation UX: lightweight inline confirm for <=1000 items (small banner + Undo). Modal only for >=1000 or destructive actions that can't be recovered. Keeps flow fast for most users. Jordan (Frontend): I'll add an e2e test that verifies: header checkbox behavior, banner appears, aria-live announces correct string, Undo cancels selection. Also add a test that "Select all" sends the filter payload + flag when clicked. Ava (A11y): Please include screen-reader-only copy for the header checkbox: "Select visible results. Press S as a shortcut to toggle selection." Also include the aria-label for the banner: "Selection banner: 12 results on this page selected." Riley (Eng): One more engineering caveat: bulk actions need to be idempotent. If a user triggers approve twice, job system should dedupe or handle duplicates safely. We'll include job dedupe by run+action+timestamp window. Casey (PM): Quick decision: copy-first + banner escalation is the path. Maria will update mocks, Jordan & Riley will sketch API contract, Ava will review a11y notes. If the team is good with that, we can ship the copy tweak as a small patch and iterate. :+1: Maria (Design): Mock updated in figma: https://figma.com/file/placeholder/bulk-selection (placeholder link). I added the two states and microcopy suggestions. Jordan (Frontend): I'll pick this up tomorrow morning. Will open a PR with the copy change and header aria updates. deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline: staging -> prod in ~2h if PR passes CI :rocket: Riley (Eng): I'll add the job API skeleton in the same sprint so backend is ready when we do the "select all" feature. Ava (A11y): I'll run a quick screen reader pass once the PR is up. Please tag me. Casey (PM): Thanks everyone. Moving to action items: Maria mock, Jordan PR for copy & aria, Riley backend sketch, Ava review. Follow-up sync if anything blocks.
